patch:
From a2905bb92e1226de5e0ef9daf5d3ac2d3dc792b2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: durable-demo <durable-demo@invalid>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 04:32:26 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] fix: slug joins every word, not just the first two

---
 slug.mjs | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/slug.mjs b/slug.mjs
index 0e4b0f4..e44685f 100644
--- a/slug.mjs
+++ b/slug.mjs
@@ -1 +1 @@
-export const slug = (text) => text.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-');
+export const slug = (text) => text.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).join('-');
--
